evidence_rules: Pin final source commit/tree, locks, binaries and protected runtime profiles together; source identity alone does not close PN0.
Report source-head and base-merge lanes separately; original #4497 paired c165 history is not the new unified source.
Retain native failures, SIGKILL, missing executions and profile refusals with exact applicable source; null evidence is not PASS.
A single binary containing multiple owners does not make incompatible backend/profile selections composable.
Treat component behavior and intentionally rejected combinations separately; no total or aggregate overrides an unsupported combination.
Do not mix ordinary cell-v2 Ed25519 FinalUse with the separate V2 ML-DSA API or the unmerged #4368 source.
Later runtime edits invalidate relevant inspected blobs and need their own results; fill the final source and current native result fields before use.
Hepta 39775... remains the requested baseline; reviewed runtime successor 3ba22376... is recorded separately. Results from either head apply only to their actual tested source.
